description: Replying to @Asam Lambung Eerie footage shows Taiwan’s tallest building – the $1.8 billion Taipei 101 skyscraper – gently swaying like a stick in the breeze during its strongest earthquake in 25 years. A 660 metric ton golden sphere called the 'tuned mass damper' hangs inside the building from the 92nd floor.  As the building moves in one direction, the steel sphere sways in the other direction and maintains the building's overall balance.  #earthquake #taiwan #taiwanearthquake #quake #news #breakingnews #skyscraper
